This compound is identified as a target of multiple agents, including 6-acetonyldihydrochelerythrine, ergocryptine, and Npc115753, all of which are linked to the Raji cell line. The shared target suggests a possible mechanism of action involving the modulation of protein kinase activity, which is a well-documented pathway in cellular signaling and disease progression. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further validation would be necessary to confirm the specific mechanism and therapeutic relevance. The presence of multiple agents targeting the same pathway supports the hypothesis that the compound may exert its effects through a common biological mechanism, potentially influencing cellular processes in Raji cells.
